disclaimer: Screening-level physical scenario simulation. Landslide 'detections' are model candidates, not confirmed field observations, and are not a certified warning service.
model: Transient infiltration + infinite-slope FS + Voellmy D8 runout (NER calibration v2.0)

profile.terrain_note: Western Ghats escarpment; deeply incised debris channels draining to Chaliyar.
profile.regolith: Lateritic soil over charnockite/gneiss with thick colluvial valley fills.
profile.threshold_source: Caine (1980) global intensity-duration envelope, regionally scaled
notes: July 2024 Chooralmala-Mundakkai debris flows (>200 deaths) are the benchmark.
Extreme orographic rainfall; transferability test, not an NER warning configuration.
